title: From Address Blocks to Authorized Prefixes: Redesigning RPKI ROV with a Hierarchical Hashing Scheme
note: h2ROV is a C data structure (hierarchical hashing over authorized prefixes) with a makefile and experiment scripts in the repo; claimed 1.7-9.8x validation speedup and 49-87% memory reduction are pure CPU/RAM metrics measurable on one machine with public RPKI/BGP dumps. Concerns: the repo README is essentially empty, so documentation is thin; the routing-convergence emulation part of the evaluation may need more setup than the data-structure benchmarks.

title: How Soon is Now? Preloading Images for Virtual Disks with ThinkAhead
note: Data-driven block preloading (prefetch/admission policy) for virtual disk images, evaluated largely by trace-driven simulation; production Alibaba EBS image-boot traces released at https://tianchi.aliyun.com/dataset/216164. Concern: the paper also reports cluster experiments on Alibaba EBS, which cannot be reproduced - only the prediction + simulation half is in reach here.

title: Kosmo: Efficient Online Miss Ratio Curve Generation for Eviction Policy Evaluation
note: Pure trace-driven MRC generation for non-inclusive eviction policies (LFU, FIFO, 2Q, LRFU). Rust binaries, public cache traces (Twitter cache-trace, 52 traces), no privileged access and no special hardware. Artifact also archived at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10569925. Only concern is trace download size against the ~257 GB free on /home, which is manageable by subsetting traces.

title: Enabling Transparent Acceleration of Big Data Frameworks using Heterogeneous Hardware
note: Transparent JIT offload of JVM big-data operators to accelerators via TornadoVM; the GPU path works on one A5000 with the NVIDIA OpenCL/PTX backend. Concern: paper also evaluates FPGA, and the Flink part must be run in local mode

title: HIRE: A Hybrid Learned Index for Robust and Efficient Performance under Mixed Workloads
note: hybrid learned in-memory index targeting tail latency and range queries - learned system component - concern: no repo located

title: Caribou: Fine-Grained Geospatial Shifting of Serverless Applications for Sustainability
note: Placement/scheduling policy for serverless workflows across regions driven by carbon, cost and latency data; the deployment solver is an offline optimizer that can be replayed against their collected carbon/price/latency datasets on one machine. Concern: end-to-end evaluation deploys to AWS Lambda and GCP across many regions, which this environment cannot do - only the solver and its input traces are locally studyable.

title: ETC: Efficient Training of Temporal Graph Neural Networks over Large-scale Dynamic Graphs
note: temporal GNN training system for large dynamic graphs; single machine GPU

title: Pre-train and Search: Efficient Embedding Table Sharding with Pre-trained Neural Cost Models
note: Learned cost model plus search for DLRM embedding-table sharding - training the cost model and running the search is a single-GPU offline workload driven by the public dlrm_datasets traces - concern - the end-to-end payoff was measured on a production multi-terabyte DLRM so only the benchmark-dataset results are reproducible here

title: SWIX: A Memory-efficient Sliding Window Learned Index
note: Memory-efficient learned index for sliding windows; CPU only

title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
note: Prefill/decode disaggregation - user-space Python on vLLM with a published simulator and cost model. Concern - real disaggregation needs 2+ GPUs so on one A5000 the study would be simulator-driven or use tiny models in separate processes

title: Carbon Explorer: A Holistic Framework for Designing Carbon Aware Datacenters
note: Trace-driven datacenter carbon/capacity simulator - pure Python user space  open source  policies are easy to extend

title: Breadcrumb Filters: Fast Fully Featured Filters
note: full-featured enumerable filter competing with vector-quotient and blocked-Bloom filters - small, self-contained storage data structure

title: NOCAP: Near-Optimal Correlation-Aware Partitioning Joins
note: I/O- and buffer-aware partitioning for storage-based hash joins; single-node NVMe, user space

title: PACE: Poisoning Attacks on Learned Cardinality Estimation
note: Poisoning attacks on learned cardinality estimators - learned component inside the query optimizer. Concern: no artifact found in GitHub search, repo unknown

title: SPADE: Signal-Aware DAG Scheduling and Dynamic Provisioning for Data Processing Clusters
note: Explicitly in-scope form: besides the Spark-on-Kubernetes prototype the authors release a *high-fidelity Spark simulator* driven by Alibaba/TPC-H traces plus carbon/price signals, which runs fine on one CPU-only host. Concern: the 100-node K8s prototype path is out of reach - the simulator is the only usable route. Merge note: the scout's repo-link cell held the PDF URL; the repository given in the scout's prose (https://github.com/umass-solar/adaptive-dag) is used here.

title: Colocating ML Inference and Training with Fast GPU Memory Handover
note: Colocates inference and training on the same GPU with millisecond-scale memory handover; the core mechanism is intra-GPU spatial sharing and the paper used 16 GB V100s, so 24 GB is ample. Concern: some experiments span 4 GPUs and the memory-reclaim hooks are tied to a specific PyTorch/CUDA version

title: Safe Optimized Static Memory Allocation for Parallel Deep Learning
note: Static tensor-offset allocation solver that minimizes peak memory for parallel execution streams - a compile-time combinatorial problem that runs on CPU and is a clean target for a better solver - concern - it was upstreamed into MindSpore rather than released as a standalone artifact so locating and rebuilding the solver inside MindSpore is a real cost

title: Channel-Aware 5G RAN Slicing with Customizable Schedulers
note: Channel-aware RAN slicing scheduler implemented entirely inside an open-source user-space RAN simulator so the whole evaluation runs on this machine with no radios - Concern: the resource being scheduled is 5G spectrum rather than CPU or GPU which stretches the scheduling topic key and the CQI trace files are large

title: Modeling Concurrency Control as a Learnable Function
note: concurrency control modelled as a learnable function mapping database states to CC actions - a learned component inside a transactional system

title: SparseTransX: Efficient Training of Translation-Based Knowledge Graph Embeddings Using Sparse Matrix Operations
note: Replaces scatter/gather embedding kernels with SpMM in knowledge-graph embedding training - CPU and single-GPU results, low GPU memory footprint - good fit for one node

title: Empowering WebAssembly with Thin Kernel Interfaces
note: WALI extends a user-space Wasm engine to expose Linux syscalls directly - a pure user-space runtime contribution buildable in $HOME. AE badges Available plus Functional plus Reproduced. Concern - the paper also targets the Zephyr RTOS which is out of reach here, so only the Linux half is reproducible, and the build needs an LLVM and Rust toolchain installed via conda

title: Visualization-aware Time Series Min-Max Caching with Error Bound Guarantees
note: adaptive in-memory min-max cache with error bounds for time-series visualization

title: Lemo: A Cache-Enhanced Learned Optimizer for Concurrent Queries
note: Learned query optimizer with a cache for concurrent queries. Concern: no artifact found in GitHub search

title: RoleML: a Role-Oriented Programming Model for Customizable Distributed Machine Learning on Edges
note: Python programming model plus runtime; roles are ordinary processes and can be co-located on a single host, and the paper's headline claim is low runtime overhead of the abstraction. Repo is by the first author. Concern: the automatic role-offloading mechanism is built on containerization and Docker/Podman are not installed, so that sub-feature would need porting to plain processes or bwrap.

title: Alsatian: Optimizing Model Search for Deep Transfer Learning
note: Model search system that shares inference work across candidate models; single GPU

title: One-shot garbage collection for in-memory OLTP through temporality-aware version storage
note: One-shot GC and temporality-aware version storage for in-memory MVCC OLTP - user-space memory reclamation on one multicore machine. Concern: no public repo located via GitHub search or web search; marked unknown rather than excluded

title: SafeLoad: Efficient Admission Control Framework for Identifying Memory-Overloading Queries in Cloud Data Warehouses
note: Admission control that predicts memory-overloading queries and reroutes them plus a released labelled benchmark; an admission and resource-management policy learnable from the published traces

title: Ethane: Debloating State Data using Compact Trie for Account-based Blockchain
note: Compact-trie redesign of the Ethereum state trie - single-node user-space storage structure. Concerns: needs large Ethereum state or block traces which may strain the 257 GB free space, and no code release found

title: Tao: Improving Resource Utilization while Guaranteeing SLO in Multi-tenant Relational Database-as-a-Service
note: Coroutine-based tasklet scheduler with SLO guarantees on top of the open-source Hyrise DBMS; pure user-space CPU scheduling

title: FlashANNS: GPU-Driven Asynchronous I/O Pipelining for Eliminating Storage-Compute Bottlenecks in Billion-Scale Similarity Search
note: GPU-driven asynchronous I/O pipelining and a lock-free I/O stack for out-of-core graph search on SSD - the contribution is storage/compute overlap - concern: billion-scale data needs scale-down - no repo located

title: Triangulating Python Performance Issues with SCALENE
note: Pure user-space Python CPU/GPU/memory profiler; sampling is signal- and allocator-based so no perf counters or root are needed. Single CPU plus one NVIDIA GPU is exactly its target. Very actively maintained so a delta over the released version must be argued carefully.

title: Low-Compilation-Cost Register Allocation in LLVM-Based Binary Translation
note: Register allocation algorithm that cuts compilation cost in LLVM-based dynamic binary translation - user-space translator work. Concerns: the host architecture is probably not x86-64 so the evaluation may need non-x86 hardware, and no code was found

title: CoroGraph: Bridging Cache Efficiency and Work Efficiency for Graph Algorithm Execution
note: coroutine-based software prefetching and cache-efficient in-memory graph engine; CPU only

title: KNighter: Transforming Static Analysis with LLM-Synthesized Checkers
note: Artifact is user-space Python plus Clang Static Analyzer checkers; it only needs Linux kernel *source* (compiled, never booted) and LLVM, both installable via conda without root. Active repo (189 stars). Concerns - requires a paid LLM API for checker synthesis, which is a real budget constraint; and the systems tie-in is analysis tooling rather than a runtime, so "performance" means synthesis cost / false-positive rate.

title: Optimizing Tensor Programs on Flexible Storage
note: Compiler-style optimization of tensor programs jointly with storage/layout formats - ML-compiler territory, CPU-only. Concern: arXiv preprint (2210.06267) contains no artifact link

title: SOWalker: An I/O-Optimized Out-of-Core Graph Processing System for Second-Order Random Walks
note: Single-machine, out-of-core, user-space C++ system; the contribution (walk matrix, benefit-aware I/O model, block-set walk updating) is pure I/O scheduling policy on local NVMe, which is exactly what this machine can measure with wall-clock timers. AE Available+Functional+Reproduced. Concerns: the repo moved from the AE-listed tzphh/SOWalker (now 404) to Teamb507/SOWalker; billion-edge graphs need substantial scratch space.

title: Achieving Low-Latency Graph-Based Vector Search via Aligning Best-First Search Algorithm with SSD
note: PipeANN is user-space SSD-aware software (io_uring/AIO on NVMe), exactly the machine's strength: 2x PM9A3 NVMe. Badges: Available + Functional + Reproduced. Concern: headline results are billion-scale (SIFT1B/SPACEV1B) which needs ~1 TB; only ~257 GB is free, so experiments must scale down to 100M-point datasets.

title: Cache Your Prompt When It’s Green — Carbon-aware Caching for Large Language Model Serving
note: Carbon-aware KV/context-cache sizing on top of LMCache, driven by Azure LLM traces and carbon-intensity data. Concern: headline numbers use Llama-3 70B which will not fit in 24 GB, so the reproduction has to scale down to a 7-8B model or run the solver in trace-driven simulation

title: Linear Layouts: Robust Code Generation of Efficient Tensor Computation Using F2
note: Linear-algebra formulation of tensor layouts inside the Triton compiler; implementation is upstream in Triton so it builds and runs on one Ampere GPU

title: Anchor: Mitigating GPU Shallow Disruptions with Decoupled Memory
note: Tsinghua storage group. Title indicates decoupling GPU memory to survive shallow (transient) GPU disruptions - a GPU memory-management mechanism that is plausible to demo on one A5000. Concern: no abstract or preprint is public yet so the scale of the evaluation is unknown. Author group page lists it but the Paper link is not live.

title: FlexiWalker: Extensible GPU Framework for Efficient Dynamic Random Walks with Runtime Adaptation
note: GPU framework for dynamic random walks - single GPU, user space, official repo at AIS-SNU/FlexiWalker

title: Testing Custom Control Planes Without the Cluster
note: The premise of the paper is testing Kubernetes-style custom control planes without provisioning a cluster, which is exactly the constraint this machine imposes. UCSC (Kuper and Quinn). Concern: no abstract or artifact is public yet, and Go would need a user-space install.

title: MorphServe: Efficient and Workload-Aware LLM Serving via Runtime Quantized Layer Swapping and KV Cache Resizing
note: Runtime quantized layer swapping plus pressure-aware KV-cache resizing on Vicuna and Llama models, driven by public Azure and BurstGPT traces which the authors already downscale to fit modest hardware. Single GPU, released code

title: Mixtera: A Data Plane for Foundation Model Training
note: declarative data plane controlling data mixtures and ordering for foundation-model training - a data-loading/preprocessing system - concern: paper scales to 256 GH200 - single-GPU operation is the normal mode

title: FASTgres: Making Learned Query Optimizer Hinting Effective
note: Classifier-based query hint selection for PostgreSQL; lightweight models, single node

title: LST-Bench: Benchmarking Log-Structured Tables in the Cloud
note: Benchmark harness for log-structured tables (Delta/Hudi/Iceberg). Concern: designed for cloud object storage and multi-node engines; a single-node Spark/Trino scale-down is possible but is not the paper's setting

title: Can Graph Reordering Speed Up Graph Neural Network Training? An Experimental Study
note: Single-node empirical study of 12 graph reordering strategies inside PyTorch Geometric and DGL - CPU and single-GPU training. Artifact released. Concern: it is an evaluation study so the improvement angle would be a new reordering or selection policy

title: VOCALExplore: Pay-as-You-Go Video Data Exploration and Model Building
note: End-to-end system for interactive video exploration - asynchronous GPU feature extraction, feature caching/persistence, background task scheduling and active-learning sample selection. The systems contributions (latency-hiding scheduler, feature reuse, automatic model/feature selection) are exactly the kind of thing that can be improved and re-measured. Evaluated on a single node with one NVIDIA A40 and 61 GB RAM; our A5000 has 24 GB instead of 48 GB, so very large batch feature extraction may need smaller batches, but video backbones (R3D/CLIP-class) fit comfortably in FP16. All user space Python, no root needed. Concern: the video datasets (Deer, Bees, K20 subsets) may need to be re-obtained or substituted. [PVLDB 16(13), added from the vldbgap-2024 shard]

title: GPS: Revisiting the Data Layout for Disk-based High-Dimensional Vector Search
note: disk-block layout and adjacency-list cache for on-SSD vector search, beating PipeANN - the contribution is data layout and caching for SSD - concern: TB-scale datasets need scale-down - no repo located

title: Communication-Efficient Graph Neural Networks with Probabilistic Neighborhood Expansion Analysis and Caching
note: VIP-based caching policy that decides which remote vertex features to cache and which to keep in GPU memory for minibatch GNN training - the caching analysis and the GPU feature cache are meaningful on one GPU with a partitioned graph in host memory - concern - the published speedups come from a multi-machine setting so cross-partition transfers must be emulated between processes

title: Data Chunk Compaction in Vectorized Execution
note: Learning-based runtime decision inside a vectorized engine (DuckDB); user space

title: From Imperative to Declarative: Towards LLM-friendly OS Interfaces for Boosted Computer-Use Agents
note: Declarative user-space OS interface layer for LLM computer-use agents - the abstraction and its runtime are user space. Concerns: evaluation needs GUI applications and paid LLM API calls, and no code was found

title: NeurBench: A Benchmark Suite for Learned Database Components with Drift Modeling: [Experiments & Analysis]
note: benchmark suite with controllable data/workload drift for learned database components - reusable harness for learned-systems experiments

title: Bagpipe - Accelerating Deep Recommendation Model Training
note: The core mechanism is a lookahead oracle cache that prefetches hot embeddings ahead of the training loop, which is meaningful with one trainer plus one cache process on a single node with one GPU. Kept as borderline per the scope rule. Concerns - serious machine risk: the released AE artifact is an EC2 cluster launcher (ec2_launcher_six_models.py) that provisions a multi-node AWS cluster and the torchrec baseline is distributed, so no single-node scale-down is provided and the team would have to build one; the audit stage should decide whether that is 10-week feasible

title: M2K: Making the Model-Kernel Interface Explicit for Reliable CUDA Kernel Verification
note: Model2Kernel does model-aware dynamic analysis to catch memory-safety bugs in CUDA kernels used by LLM inference engines such as vLLM. Single GPU is enough to run the checker. Official repo linked from the preprint. Concern: some target kernels may be written for newer architectures than Ampere.

title: Efficient Auditing of Event-driven Web Applications
note: Karousos is a record-replay runtime for Node.js web applications; the improvement axis is the recording/replay overhead, which is a straightforward user-space runtime performance problem on a single host. Concern - framed as a security-auditing paper rather than a classic performance paper, so the hypothesis has to be written carefully around overhead

title: SparseTIR: Composable Abstractions for Sparse Compilation in Deep Learning
note: Sparse tensor compilation for DL on a single NVIDIA GPU - GitHub + Zenodo AE artifact  well documented

title: Optimizing Dynamic Neural Networks with Brainstorm
note: Framework for dynamic (sparsely activated, MoE-style) networks using Cell and Router abstractions plus profile-guided dynamic optimisation; single-GPU inference workloads, and the memory-saving results are attractive on a 24 GB card. Concern: some evaluated models are large MoEs that will need to be scaled down. AE branch: https://github.com/Raphael-Hao/brainstorm/tree/osdi2023ae .

title: Trinity: Three-Dimensional Tensor Program Optimization via Tile-level Equality Saturation
note: Tile-level equality saturation tensor compiler emitting Triton kernels; single-GPU compile-and-benchmark loop

title: CHARM: Chiplet Heterogeneity-Aware Runtime Mapping System
note: User-space runtime that maps tasks to chiplets - this host is a chiplet-based Zen3 Threadripper so the hardware target matches. Concerns: the technique very likely needs PMU-based cache and bandwidth monitoring which is blocked by perf_event_paranoid=3, and no code was found

title: A Deep Dive into Common Open Formats for Analytical DBMSs
note: Deep evaluation of Parquet/ORC/Arrow open columnar formats; CPU and disk only, ideal reproduce-and-improve target

title: Towards Iterative Relational Algebra on the GPU
note: Single-GPU CUDA library: open-addressing hash table, operator fusion, two deduplication variants, evaluated on transitive closure against cuDF and Souffle. No multi-GPU, no root, no exotic hardware. AE Available+Functional+Reproduced. Concerns: it is a short paper, so the design space is small; the baselines (cuDF via RAPIDS, Souffle) need conda/source installs, and large relations can exceed 24 GB of GPU memory.

title: Rethinking the Encoding of Integers for Scans on Skewed Data
note: Integer encoding for bit-parallel scans with early pruning; CPU/SIMD only. Concern: checked GitHub and web search, no artifact link found

title: FlexiQ: Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Latency/Accuracy Trade-Offs in Deep Neural Networks
note: Adaptive mixed-precision quantization with a GPU inference runtime - CV models fit easily on the A5000. Concerns: part of the prototype targets a custom NPU, and no code release was found

title: Caerus: A Caching-based Framework for Scalable Temporal Graph Neural Networks
note: Published as Orca: staleness-aware caching of node embeddings to cut temporal-GNN training cost - a cache policy question on one GPU. Concern: title differs between the program page and the final paper

title: Chipmink: Efficient Delta Identification for Massive Object Graphs
note: Delta identification and incremental persistence for large Python object graphs replacing full pickle snapshots; user-space storage and dedup work with an open artifact

title: Transparent GPU Sharing in Container Clouds for Deep Learning Workloads
note: OS-layer GPU sharing for DL training that intercepts CUDA driver API calls from user space so two jobs can share the single A5000 - Concern: the artifact is packaged for Docker plus Kubernetes which are unavailable here so it must be ported to plain processes and the transparent-unified-memory path may need driver privileges

title: Aleph Filter: To Infinity in Constant Time
note: expandable filter with constant-time operations under growth; user-space C++

title: Lucid: A Non-intrusive, Scalable and Interpretable Scheduler for Deep Learning Training Jobs
note: DL-cluster scheduler evaluated by trace-driven simulation with public traces - runs entirely on one CPU host

title: Evaluating Chiplet-based Large-Scale Interconnection Networks via Cycle-Accurate Packet-Parallel Simulation
note: The artifact is a user-space parallel discrete-event simulator whose headline claim is simulation speed, which is measurable and improvable on 16 cores with no special hardware. Concern: the subject matter is chiplet interconnect architecture rather than systems software, so topic fit needs an audit decision

title: Homomorphic Compression: Making Text Processing on Compression Unlimited
note: Compression format that supports processing directly on compressed text; CPU only

title: ngAP: Non-blocking Large-scale Automata Processing on GPUs
note: GPU automata-processing engine; artifact was tested on an RTX 3090 (Ampere 24 GB) which matches the A5000 almost exactly. Clear room for scheduling/memoization improvements.

title: Optimizing Collections of Bloom Filters within a Space Budget
note: joint space allocation across a collection of Bloom filters; small self-contained user-space artifact

title: GPU Checkpoint/Restore Made Fast and Lightweight
note: Distinguished Artifact Award; single-GPU system-level checkpoint/restore via CUDA API interception and CPU shadow execution - the mechanism is single-GPU by construction. Concerns worth auditing: the cuda-checkpoint baseline needs a newer NVIDIA driver than the installed 535.216.01, and CRIU-style process checkpointing often needs elevated privileges, which are unavailable here.

title: Hidet: Task-Mapping Programming Paradigm for Deep Learning Tensor Programs
note: DL compiler with task-mapping scheduling - single NVIDIA GPU actively maintained open source  Ampere supported

title: OUTRE: An OUT-of-core De-REdundancy GNN Training Framework for Massive Graphs within A Single Machine
note: out-of-core GNN training explicitly designed for a single machine

title: QStore: Quantization-Aware Compressed Model Storage
note: Lossless joint storage of high and low precision model weights as base plus residual; a compression and model-storage contribution that needs no large GPU

title: A Hybrid Runtime for Function-as-a-Service at the Edge
note: RUNE combines containers and WebAssembly (WasmEdge) in one FaaS runtime and trades cold-start latency against idle-container memory - a user-space runtime/placement-policy question that is a natural single-node improvement target (better hybrid placement policy, measured as p99 latency vs. memory). Concern: repo is unknown - the paper states RUNE is open source but no URL surfaced from GitHub search on the system name, the authors' handles (Adam Hall, Umakishore Ramachandran, Georgia Tech), or web search, and the ACM full text is unreachable from this host. Concern: the container half of the hybrid needs a container runtime that is not installed and requires a rootless port. Both must be settled at audit.

title: Towards Designing and Learning Piecewise Space-Filling Curves
note: Learned piecewise space-filling curve for multidimensional indexing; Python plus C++, single node

title: Active Data Lakes: Regaining Physical Data Independence Without Losing Interoperability
note: Mechanisms that restore physical data independence over Parquet-based data lakes so new storage layouts can be adopted without breaking interoperability; user-space file-format and storage work
